scope: SECOND_SHARD_ONLY metadata inventory, not union/full source cohort, English/quality/rights/tokens/admissions.

schema.duplicate_JSON_keys: Explicit whole-record hold before any parsed-field use, nested keys included.
schema.unknown_or_bad_rows: Every complete physical line retained as ordinal/offset/length/LF/rawSHA/flags even if malformed, duplicate-key or oversized; never silently skip.
schema.oversized: Consume/hash entire line in fixed chunks without parsing; mid-line cap produces only prefix hash explicitly not whole-line hash.

storage: Append-only records SQLite no text copy; exact scalar fields up to4096UTF8B, otherwise overflow hold+rawline backing; compact text SHA/bytes/chars, rawlicense evidence, conservative derived family leads.
exception_storage: At most12MB schema-only exception JSONL with ordered bytes/SHA and counts; flags/counters preserve family/license/date uncertainty without serializing allnormal metadata twice.
atomicity: Append-only batches100; PRAGMA max_page_count112MB, synchronousFULL PERSIST rollback journal (retained through commit/rollback/close,8MB reserve limit),4MBcache. Prewrite conservative rowgrowth+8MB journal/terminal reservation and128MB aggregate guard; any stop preserves only committed prefix and partial counters. No resume/retry.
source: Existing publisher hash+independent receipt/stat. Readonce O_RDONLY/NOFOLLOW, full compressedSHA and every gzip memberCRC/EOF/trailing check before COMPLETE.
known_hold: Production local known_holds is empty because firstshard ordinal1 is wrongsource here. Exact first held ID/textSHA/rawline/sourceordinal/review remain pinned in cross_source_known_holds for future union propagation; no blanket license or quality decision.

v2_census_and_journal.census: Shared reviewed helper673eee91fdb2ca8a36db17b1e6d9c4656dd67d1ef581021fc40abb9d34b9b538: one-stat/lstat per path; anyENOENT restarts entire scan up to8 attempts; persistent churn/other errors failclosed. Never skip renamed files.
v2_census_and_journal.SQLite_mode: PERSIST retains rollback journal through commit/rollback/close; temp_store=MEMORY and no WAL; mode change proposed to avoid journal-unlink races in already-frozen live Hansard scanner. No live code patch. Parent must review compatibility before dispatch; may queue until HS terminal.
v2_census_and_journal.journal_guard: Existing8MB prewrite reserve now explicit max journal bytes check after every insert; journal_size_limit8MB at commit; all existing2GBdecoded/100krows/112MBDB/128MBaggregate/570-600s/1GBRSS unchanged.
v2_census_and_journal.old_failure: All v1 code/partial outputs/journals preserved; no reusing or resuming failed DB.
